# 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(hdm)
library(pROC)

library(tidyr)

```

# 2. Load Data

```{r}
macro <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

macro_fin <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_financial_clean_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

dim(macro)
dim(macro_fin)
#names(macro)

# Check if recession indicator exists
"USREC" %in% names(macro)
"USREC" %in% names(macro_fin)

range(macro_fin$sasdate)
```

#3. EDA; Checking of recessions (can move to seperate Rmd downstream)
```{r}
recession_data <- macro_fin %>%
  select(sasdate, USREC) %>%
  arrange(sasdate) %>%
  mutate(
    recession_start = USREC == 1 & lag(USREC, default = 0) == 0,
    recession_id = cumsum(recession_start)
  ) %>%
  filter(USREC == 1) %>%
  group_by(recession_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_date = min(sasdate),
    end_date = max(sasdate),
    duration_months = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-recession_id)

print(recession_data)

# recommended cutoff, referenced from research papers
cutoff <- as.Date("1986-01-01")

recession_data %>%
  mutate(
    sample = case_when(
      end_date < cutoff ~ "Training",
      start_date >= cutoff ~ "Testing",
      TRUE ~ "Crosses cutoff"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(start_date, end_date, duration_months, sample)
```

#4. Target Construction
```{r}

create_targets <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(sasdate)
  for (h in c(3, 6, 12)) {
    future_recession <- sapply(
      seq_len(nrow(df)),
      function(i) {
        future_rows <- (i + 1):(i + h)
        # Exclude observations without complete future data
        if (max(future_rows) > nrow(df)) {
          return(NA_integer_)
        }
        future_values <- df$USREC[future_rows]
        # Handle missing recession indicators
        if (any(is.na(future_values))) {
          return(NA_integer_)
        }

        # 1 if any future month is recessionary
        as.integer(any(future_values == 1))
      }
    )
    df[[paste0("Y_", h)]] <- future_recession
  }
  return(df)
}


macro <- create_targets(macro)
macro_fin <- create_targets(macro_fin)

#logic check
macro %>%
  select(sasdate, USREC, Y_3, Y_6, Y_12) %>%
  filter(
    sasdate >= as.Date("2007-01-01"),
    sasdate <= as.Date("2008-06-01")
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

#5. Train-test split
```{r}
test_start <- as.Date("1986-01-01")

# Label training and testing periods
macro <- macro %>%
  mutate(sample = if_else(sasdate < test_start, "train", "test"))

macro_fin <- macro_fin %>%
  mutate(sample = if_else(sasdate < test_start, "train", "test"))

table(macro$sample)
table(macro_fin$sample)

# check correctness of split
macro %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(start_date = min(sasdate), end_date = max(sasdate), observations = n(), recession_months = sum(USREC == 1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop")

macro_fin %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(start_date = min(sasdate), end_date = max(sasdate), observations = n(), recession_months = sum(USREC == 1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

#6. Check for missing values in predictors
```{r}
# identify columns with missing values
macro %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  filter(missing_count > 0)

macro_fin %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  filter(missing_count > 0)

# where does the missing values occur
predictor_cols <- setdiff(
  names(macro),
  c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
)

macro %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(predictor_cols), is.na)) %>%
  select(sasdate, all_of(predictor_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_count = rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(predictor_cols))))
  ) %>%
  select(sasdate, missing_count)
```
#7. Missing value treatment (basic forward imputation for simplicity, can consider others... check if missing value is due to missingness of raw FRED data)

```{r}
forward_fill <- function(df) {
  predictor_cols <- setdiff(
    names(df),
    c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
  )
  df %>%
    arrange(sasdate) %>%
    fill(all_of(predictor_cols), .direction = "down")
}

macro_model <- forward_fill(macro)
macro_fin_model <- forward_fill(macro_fin)

# verify correctness of forward fill

# anymore na values in dataset
predictor_cols_macro <- setdiff(
  names(macro_model),
  c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
)

predictor_cols_fin <- setdiff(
  names(macro_fin_model),
  c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
)

sum(is.na(macro_model[predictor_cols_macro]))
sum(is.na(macro_fin_model[predictor_cols_fin]))

# check that existing values were not modified, only missing values are imputed

check_imputation <- function(original, imputed) {

predictor_cols <- setdiff(
    names(original),
    c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
  )

unchanged <- all(
    sapply(predictor_cols, function(col) {
      idx <- !is.na(original[[col]])
      identical(
        original[[col]][idx],
        imputed[[col]][idx]
      )
    })
  )
  return(unchanged)
}


check_imputation(macro, macro_model)
check_imputation(macro_fin, macro_fin_model)
```
#8. LASSO model (macro only predictors at 3 month horizon)

```{r}
# training data : exclude rows whose 3-months outcomes extend beyond Dec 1985

train_data <- macro_model %>%
  filter(sasdate < as.Date("1986-01-01"), sasdate <= as.Date("1985-09-01"), !is.na(Y_3))

X_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, predictor_cols])
y_train <- train_data$Y_3

dim(X_train)
table(y_train)

# Estimate standard lasso
lasso_3m <- rlassologit(x=X_train, y=y_train, post=FALSE)

# Estimate post lasso
post_lasso_3m <- rlassologit(x=X_train, y=y_train, post=TRUE)

summary(lasso_3m)
summary(post_lasso_3m)
coef(lasso_3m)
coef(post_lasso_3m)

# training fitted probabilities
p_lasso <- as.numeric(
  predict(lasso_3m, newdata = X_train, type = "response")
)

p_post <- as.numeric(
  predict(post_lasso_3m, newdata = X_train, type = "response")
)

summary(p_lasso)
summary(p_post)

range(p_lasso)
range(p_post)
```

```{r}
fit_lasso <- function(train_data, horizon, post=FALSE) {
  target <- paste0("Y_", horizon)
  # exclude variables that should not be predictors
  predictor_cols <- setdiff(
    names(train_data),
    c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
  )
  
  # prepare x and y
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[,predictor_cols])
  y_train <- train_data[[target]]
  
  # estimate model
  model <- rlassologit(x=x_train, y=y_train, post=post)
  return(model)
}

train_3m <- macro_model %>%
  filter(
    sasdate <= as.Date("1985-09-01"),
    !is.na(Y_3)
  )

train_3m <- macro_model %>%
  filter(sasdate <= as.Date("1985-09-01"), !is.na(Y_3))

# Standard LASSO
lasso_3m <- fit_lasso(
  train_data = train_3m,
  horizon = 3,
  post = FALSE
)

# Post-LASSO
post_lasso_3m <- fit_lasso(
  train_data = train_3m,
  horizon = 3,
  post = TRUE
)


```
